claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ephedrine is a sympathomimetic amine that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells directly; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress or general amine off-target activity rather than adrenergic receptor agonism.
